intro: Qatar is one of the world's biggest exporters of liquefied natural gas and one of the richest countries per person.

chapters.title: Gas
text: LNG tankers carry Qatari gas to Asia and Europe. The Qatar Investment Authority owns stakes in companies and buildings around the world.

chapters.title: Air hub
text: Qatar Airways and Hamad International Airport connect the world through Doha.

keyTerms.meaning: A state fund that invests abroad.

cardGroups.title: Made in Qatar
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Qatar makes and sells to the world.
